item.name: Complete a file upload (confirm S3 object)

request.name: Complete a file upload (confirm S3 object)

description.content: Client calls this after uploading to S3. If success=true (default), server verifies the S3 object exists via HeadObject and transitions INITIATED → UPLOADED. If success=false, server transitions INITIATED → FAILED (client-signaled failure). For T&C uploads use POST /terms/attachments/:attachmentId/complete (stricter auth).
